prompt: Sync my instructions across all agents.
setup: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, and ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md each contain an agent-parity managed block, and all three blocks differ from one another.
The Codex file was modified most recently.
expected: The report labels the Codex block as a provisional baseline, shows a bounded diff for the other two, and marks them out of date.
The response asks which agent or file is the source before applying anything.
must_not: Apply the provisional baseline to any file.
Pick a source silently by recency, size, or agent order.
Merge the three blocks into a new text.
